retainedCostJustification: Sound Check sync-strip/keyboard, joint fix/recheck and export gates drive distinct critical UI/session/job workflows. Full shell mounts protect live workspace/mode wiring. The panel starvation case retains its 180ms split workload and 4ms ticker because scheduler starvation is the historical failure. Project-open batching requires more than 1000 media keys to cross its public batch cap.
remainingOpportunities: Sound Check nominal fake jobs still repeat 400ms polling while progress/cancel cases uniquely require asynchronous progression; safely optimizing the broad fixture needs separate lifecycle validation.
Import/startup dominates owned-batch wall time; mutable state/worker isolation was retained.
limits: Child did not run repository-wide lint/build/test, Playwright, extended fuzz, native/GL/Remotion/desktop suites; parent owns integrated final gates.
No full 63-file before measurement or measured CI savings; full-suite baseline/final comparison belongs to the parent.
